validation: Flutter Analyze reported no issues; all 171 Flutter tests passed. New coverage includes SQLite account reopen, unique normalized email, duplicate registration races, wrong passwords, Unicode and whitespace passwords, production work factor, remembered sessions, deletion, queued logout, zero HTTP requests in local mode, and the full create/logout/login/relaunch UI flow. Arabic and English forms were checked at 320 pixels and 1.6x text scale. Additional cases reject malformed commas, internal spaces, invalid domain labels and dot placement consistently in the form and account store. A well-formed address on an unfamiliar provider remains accepted; no mailbox-existence check is claimed.
native: The isolated Growza Verification package passed a native Moto G75 account test using production SQLite, secure storage and the 600,000-round password derivation. Registration, database/service reopen, session restore, logout, wrong-password rejection, login, duplicate-email rejection and account deletion succeeded. Only synthetic fixture credentials were used and removed. No user account was created by this test. This functional run is not a performance benchmark.
delivery: The final APK, including neutral sign-in wording and stricter email syntax, was installed and launched on Moto G75. SQLite checks retained study data and any existing local credential rows during installation; no runtime errors were observed. Corrected Arabic/English forms were visually reviewed using synthetic narrow-screen previews. No UI automation entered or altered personal credentials. No Supabase project, email service, cloud AI endpoint or synchronization was enabled. iOS and web local accounts remain unvalidated.
